meta.name: The Yoga of Knowledge and Realisation
meta.outline: Verses 1–3: Krishna promises full knowledge, and says how rare it is to truly know him; 4–7: his two natures, with everything strung on him like pearls on a thread; 8–12: where to see him in everyday things; 13–15: maya, and why people fail to see him; 16–19: the four kinds of people who worship him; 20–23: the worship of other gods; 24–30: the unseen Krishna, and those who come to know him.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु
words: with your mind attached to me
verses.tr: Krishna said: Arjuna, hear how you will come to know me fully and without doubt, by practising yoga with your mind fixed on me and taking shelter in me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: I shall teach you this knowledge in full, along with the direct experience of it. Once you know it, nothing more remains to be known here.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: and even among those who strive and succeed
verses.tr: Among thousands of people, hardly one strives for perfection. And even among those who strive and succeed, hardly one knows me as I truly am.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च
verses.tr: Earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, intellect and ego: this is my nature, divided into eight parts.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: which is the life in beings
by which this world is held up
verses.tr: That is my lower nature. Know that I have another, higher nature, Arjuna: the life in all beings, by which this whole world is held up.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: I am, of the whole world
verses.tr: Understand that all beings are born from these two natures. I am the origin of the whole world, and I am also its end.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
words: there is nothing else at all
all this is strung on me
verses.tr: There is nothing higher than me, Arjuna. All of this is strung on me, like pearls on a thread.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु
words: I am the taste in water
I am the light of the moon and the sun
the syllable Om in all the Vedas
verses.tr: Arjuna, I am the taste in water and the light of the moon and the sun. I am Om in all the Vedas, the sound in space and the ability in people.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ
words: the pure fragrance in the earth
I am the brightness in fire
and I am the discipline of the disciplined
verses.tr: I am the pure fragrance of the earth and the brightness of fire. I am the life in all beings and the self-discipline of those who practise it.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्
words: me as the seed of all beings
I am the intelligence of the intelligent
I am the brilliance of the brilliant
verses.tr: Know me, Arjuna, as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the intelligence of the intelligent and the brilliance of the brilliant.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: I am the strength of the strong
I am the desire in beings
verses.tr: I am the strength of the strong, when it is free from craving and attachment. And I am the desire in beings that does not go against dharma, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि
words: and those of passion (rajas) and dullness (tamas)
know that they come from me alone
yet I am not in them
verses.tr: Whatever states arise from goodness, passion or dullness, know that they all come from me. Yet I am not in them; they are in me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: by these three states made of the gunas
verses.tr: The whole world is deluded by these three states born of the gunas. So it does not recognise me, who am beyond them and never change.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते
words: maya of mine, made of the gunas
those who take refuge in me alone
verses.tr: This divine maya of mine, made of the three gunas, is very hard to cross. But those who take refuge in me alone cross over it.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः
words: do not take refuge in me
whose understanding maya has carried away
who have taken up a demonic nature
verses.tr: Wrongdoers who are deluded, the lowest among people, do not take refuge in me. Maya has carried away their understanding, and they have taken up a demonic nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the one who wants to know
the one who seeks some gain
verses.tr: Four kinds of good people worship me, Arjuna: the one in distress, the one who wants to understand, the one who seeks some gain, and the one who knows.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः
words: among them, the one who knows
for I am very dear to the one who knows
and he is dear to me
verses.tr: Of these, the one who knows stands out, always united with me and devoted to me alone. I am very dear to such a person, and that person is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्
words: but the one who knows is my very self
in me alone as the highest goal
verses.tr: All of them are noble, but the one who knows I regard as my very self. With a steady mind, such a person is settled in me alone as the highest goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: at the end of many births
the one with knowledge takes refuge in me
verses.tr: After many births, the one who has knowledge takes refuge in me, seeing that Vasudeva is everything. Such a great soul is very rare.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया
words: following this or that rule of worship
verses.tr: Those whose understanding is carried away by one desire or another turn to other gods. Led by their own nature, they follow this or that rule of worship.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति
verses.tr: Whatever form a devotee wishes to worship with faith, I make that person's faith in it steady.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्
words: and gains from it what he desires
though it is I alone who grant these
verses.tr: Filled with that faith, the person worships that form and gets what was wished for. But it is I alone who grant those wishes.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: but the result they gain has an end
it is for those of small understanding
those who worship the gods go to the gods
verses.tr: But the reward these people of small understanding gain comes to an end. Those who worship the gods go to the gods; my devotees come to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the unseen that has taken a visible form
so those without understanding think of me
verses.tr: Those without understanding think that I, the unseen, have merely taken a visible form. They do not know my higher nature, which is unchanging and supreme.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: I am not visible to everyone
verses.tr: Covered by my own maya, I am not visible to everyone. This deluded world does not recognise me, the unborn and unchanging.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन
words: and the beings yet to come
verses.tr: Arjuna, I know all beings of the past, the present and the future. But no one knows me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Arjuna, all beings fall into confusion from birth, through the delusion of opposites that rises from wanting and disliking.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: whose wrongdoing has come to an end
they, freed from the delusion of opposites
verses.tr: But people who act rightly, whose wrongdoing has come to an end, are freed from the delusion of opposites. They worship me, firm in their vows.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्
words: for freedom from old age and death
those who strive, taking shelter in me
the whole truth of the self
verses.tr: Those who take shelter in me and strive for freedom from old age and death come to know Brahman, the whole truth of the self, and all about karma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः
words: me as what underlies the elements and the gods
even at the time of death
verses.tr: Those who know me as the one who underlies the elements, the gods and all sacrifice keep a steady mind and know me even at the time of death.
